title: Paper baseline waits for a snapshot that only its own persona can trigger

prior_review_findings_addressed.p1_missing_source_provisioning_prerequis: Independent review found that moving the snapshot wait after persona creation was not sufficient: the BFF's async provisioning reconciler (_persona_provisioning_reconciler_loop, services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py) only evaluates lifecycle readbacks and never provisions source connectors, and the source-ingest controller's own scheduler tick (services/source_ingestion/controller_worker.py:load_desired_state) reads a static desired-state file/URL that has no knowledge of a Persona created after that file was written. On a fresh host neither path ever registers dev-paper-us-equity-simulation for a newly created Persona.
prior_review_findings_addressed.p2_freshness_gate_bypassed_on_replay: Independent review reproduced base-vs-head with a stale SPY snapshot and a terminal successful create response: base raised market_input_stale (one snapshot GET); head returned ok with zero snapshot GETs, because the early paper_running/succeeded return (then at lines 410-428) preceded the snapshot wait.

owned: scripts/bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py: added ensure_source_provisioning() and source_ingest_controller_token(), and moved both the source provisioning call and the market snapshot wait to run unconditionally right after Persona creation/terminal-failure checks and before ANY success return (first-run or idempotent replay)

scripts/test_bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py: regression coverage for the governed source provisioning call ordering, and for the freshness gate on an idempotent successful replay (stale/missing/fresh)
not_changing: services/source_ingestion/persona_source_reconciler.py: connector/schedule provisioning logic and its dev-only PANTHEON_ENV=dev gate for dev-paper-us-equity-simulation are unmodified. bootstrap now calls this reconciler's own HTTP endpoint (services/source_ingestion/routers/catalog_controller.py POST /api/source-ingest/persona-source-provisioning/reconcile) directly instead of waiting on an external tick to reach it.

services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py: _evaluate_persona_provisioning_status / _persona_provisioning_reconciler_loop and required_data_sources declaration are unmodified. The BFF's own reconciler loop still only evaluates lifecycle readbacks; this task does not add source provisioning inside the BFF process. The fix instead has the operator-side bootstrap script call source-ingest directly, which converges without changing the BFF saga's blast radius.
ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready's freshness/admissibility rules (staleness threshold, future-timestamp rejection, minimum closes) -- unchanged
composes_with: the async persona provisioning reconciler loop (_persona_provisioning_reconciler_loop, default 5s interval) for lifecycle/runtime-binding readback, which still runs unchanged and in parallel

the source-ingest controller's own scheduled tick (source-ingest-scheduler, default 60s interval), which will also converge once the static desired-state file lists a persona -- unaffected by this change
deliberately_not_attempted: Wiring the source-ingest controller's own desired-state discovery (SOURCE_INGEST_DESIRED_STATE_PATH/_URL) to read personas dynamically from the BFF/persona store. That is a larger, separate architectural change (replacing a static per-deployment file with a live persona-store-backed authority) and was judged out of scope for this ordering-deadlock fix; the governed persona-source-provisioning/reconcile endpoint the desired-state controller itself calls already gives an authoritative, synchronous provisioning path that does not require that larger change.

docker-compose.yml wiring to actually deliver a SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_TOKEN[/_FILE] into the operator-bff container. An initial attempt (mounting the existing source-ingest-data volume read-only into operator-bff and pointing SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_TOKEN_FILE at the token source-ingest already creates) was reverted: docker-compose.yml is outside this task's declared artifact contract (scripts/bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py, services/source_ingestion/persona_source_reconciler.py, services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py, scripts/test_bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py, docs/deployment/evidence/DEV-PAPER-SNAPSHOT-PRECONDITION-ORDERING-001/) and the governed handoff command rejected it outright ('changed file docker-compose.yml is outside the task artifact contract'). See known_gap below.

known_gap.summary: The code-level fix (ensure_source_provisioning, called before any success return in ensure_paper_baseline) is complete and covered by regression tests, but it cannot actually run end to end against a real deployment yet because operator-bff has no path today to the source-ingest controller token it needs to authenticate the mutating persona-source-provisioning/reconcile call.
known_gap.why_not_fixed_here: source-ingest's reconcile endpoint requires a controller-owned bearer token (services/source_ingestion/runtime.py:_require_controller_authorization), created and held only on the source-ingest-data volume shared between the source-ingest and source-ingest-scheduler containers. operator-bff shares neither that volume nor any existing env var with source-ingest for this purpose. Delivering the credential therefore requires a docker-compose.yml change (a read-only volume mount plus one env var), which is outside this task's declared artifact contract; the governed handoff command enforces this and rejected an initial attempt that included the docker-compose.yml edit.
known_gap.recommendation: Open a narrowly scoped companion task (or expand this task's artifact contract) to add exactly two lines to operator-bff's docker-compose.yml service definition: a read-only mount of the existing source-ingest-data volume at /data/source-ingest, and SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_TOKEN_FILE=/data/source-ingest/controller_token. No new credential needs to be minted; source-ingest already creates that token at its own startup. Once that lands, ensure_source_provisioning already has the correct request shape and auth handling to complete the fix without further code changes.
known_gap.impact_on_acceptance: AC1 and AC5 (a first deploy onto a host with zero data source instances completes the governed paper baseline end to end) remain open until that companion wiring lands and a hosted run is captured. AC2, AC3, AC4, and AC6 are satisfied by this PR: the wait no longer depends on a snapshot whose producer is declared later in its own sequence, the wait stays bounded and still names the symbol/stale snapshot, no freshness rule was relaxed, and regression tests cover both the never-provisioned first-run ordering and the already-fresh/replay steady-state paths.

implementation.governed_source_provisioning_prerequisit: Added ensure_source_provisioning(), which POSTs {persona: {persona_id, lifecycle_state, required_data_sources}, dry_run: false} to source-ingest's own POST /api/source-ingest/persona-source-provisioning/reconcile with an Authorization: Bearer <source-ingest controller token>. This is the exact authoritative endpoint services/source_ingestion/controller_worker.py:reconcile_desired_state itself calls to provision connectors/schedules; calling it directly after Persona creation removes the dependency on either the BFF's readback-only reconciler or the static desired-state file/URL. required_data_sources is taken from the create-paper-bundle response's requiredDataSources/required_data_sources field when present, falling back to the known dev-only DEV_US_REQUIRED_DATA_SOURCES constant (mirrors services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py:_market_persona_required_data_sources(market='US') under PANTHEON_ENV=dev) when the response omits it.
implementation.controller_token_wiring: Added source_ingest_controller_token(), read-only counterpart to services/source_ingestion/controller_auth.load_controller_token: prefers an explicit SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_TOKEN env var, else reads a file path from SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_TOKEN_FILE. Neither is currently populated in the deployed operator-bff container -- see known_gap below -- so ensure_source_provisioning will raise a named BootstrapError ('governed source provisioning prerequisite requires a source-ingest controller token ... but none is configured') until that credential is supplied through whatever mechanism the deploy pipeline uses to inject dev secrets into operator-bff (docker-compose.yml env/volume wiring is outside this task's artifact contract; see known_gap).
implementation.call_ordering_fix: Both ensure_source_provisioning() and ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready() now run unconditionally right after the terminal-failure check and before the paper_running/succeeded early return, instead of after it. This means: (a) first-run: the Persona (and its required_data_sources declaration) already exists by this point, so provisioning can never deadlock on a producer that does not exist yet; (b) idempotent successful replay: the freshness gate is no longer skipped on the early-return path, closing the P2 regression the independent review reproduced (stale snapshot + terminal successful create must still raise market_input_stale, not return ok).
implementation.bounded_wait_preserved: ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready itself is unchanged: it still bounds its wait, still names the symbol and last-seen reason on timeout, still refuses stale/future/insufficient snapshots, and still nudges run-scheduled on 404.
implementation.no_freshness_relaxation: No snapshot admissibility, staleness, or fabrication rule was touched.
implementation.no_new_endpoints: No new BFF, source-ingest, or reconciler HTTP endpoints or schemas were added; only an existing source-ingest endpoint is now called by an additional caller.

passed.note: Includes: governed source-provisioning call-order regressions (never-provisioned first-run, already-fresh steady-state); AC4 replay regressions (test_replay_with_stale_snapshot_still_raises_market_input_stale, test_replay_with_missing_snapshot_still_raises_market_snapshot_not_found, test_replay_with_fresh_snapshot_returns_ok_after_one_get); unit coverage for ensure_source_provisioning and source_ingest_controller_token.

Unmodified by this task; run to confirm the reconciler behavior bootstrap now depends on synchronously (including test_dev_only_us_simulation_connector_provisioned_when_pantheon_env_dev, which proves the dev-paper-us-equity-simulation connector/schedule are created for a US persona under PANTHEON_ENV=dev) is unaffected.
Confirms docker-compose.yml is unchanged in this delivery after reverting the out-of-scope wiring attempt (see known_gap).

not_performed.gap: A live hosted first deploy onto a fresh dev VM with zero prior data_source_instances (AC1/AC5), proving: persona create -> persona-source-provisioning/reconcile provisions dev-paper-us-equity-simulation -> run-scheduled executes it -> a fresh SPY snapshot appears -> paper_running is reached, end to end through the real operator-bff/source-ingest/postgres stack.
not_performed.reason: Blocked on known_gap (operator-bff has no path to the source-ingest controller token yet) as well as requiring a full docker-compose dev stack bring-up on a real or ephemeral dev host, which is a shared-infrastructure deploy action outside this bounded worker session. The unit-level evidence above verifies the new call ordering and the exact HTTP contract against source-ingest's real, unmodified reconcile endpoint semantics (via the existing, passing test_persona_source_reconciler.py suite plus this task's mocked-transport regressions of bootstrap's own call sequence), but does not substitute for that hosted proof.
not_performed.recommended_next_step: Land the known_gap companion wiring (or expand this task's artifact contract to include docker-compose.yml), then trigger an actual dev-host redeploy and capture: controller/readback showing dev-paper-us-equity-simulation configured+scheduled, a fresh /api/source-ingest/snapshots/latest?symbol=SPY response, and the persona reaching paper_running, all from a host with data_source_instances=0 beforehand.

review_decision.note: Independently verify: the governed source provisioning prerequisite (ensure_source_provisioning) runs before the market snapshot wait on both the first-run and idempotent-replay paths; the freshness gate is no longer bypassed on a successful replay with a stale snapshot; and that AC1/AC5 remain explicitly open pending the known_gap companion docker-compose.yml wiring and a hosted first-deploy end-to-end run, rather than being silently claimed as closed.
